name: MaryAnn Black Summer Internship at Duke Health
org: Duke Health and Duke Community Affairs, with Durham YouthWorks
what_you_do: A hybrid summer internship at Duke Health. In 2026 students spent three weeks touring clinical spaces, learning skills and hearing from Duke employees about their careers.
who_can_apply: Durham City or Durham County residents between 14 and 24 as of June 30, 2026, per the Duke page. The Duke article describes participants as Durham-area high school students.
pay_detail: Described as a paid internship. The pay amount is not stated on the pages read.
duration: 3 weeks (2026: July 6-24, Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.)
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: Durham YouthWorks application opened January 23 and closed February 21, 2026; orientation in March. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Submit the Durham YouthWorks application and select the healthcare category (link on the Duke Community Affairs page). Contact: Kimberly Monroe, kimberly.monroe@duke.edu.
notes: Applications go through Durham YouthWorks (City of Durham), whose own page could not be read (blocked). The article says about 50 students were planned for the latest class. North Carolina requires a Youth Employment Certificate for anyone under 18 who works; the employer starts that process.
